Re-check these debrid records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- debrid/hubcloud $.reliability_note: Capture is a GoDaddy for-sale page for HubCloud.xyz; it does not show a DNS timeout, a 503, hubcloud.ink 204, or the hubcloud.foo to hubcloud.ist redirect.
- debrid/megaseed-kz $.interface_detail: Capture proves FTP/FTPS access and that file-host upload is unsupported; 'ruTorrent' and 'MediaInfo' are not in the FAQ capture.
- debrid/debriditalia $.identity_cost.kind: Revolut payment link does not prove an email identity cost.
- debrid/megaseed-kz $.limits: Quote proves the manual provisioning clause; per-object-cap from /compare (disk plan size) is not in this capture.
- debrid/filepress $.chaining: Quote proves only multi-cloud mirroring via API; the chain claim (index site, Drive id, HubCloud/DriveSeed/GDFlix) is not in the capture.
- debrid/megaseed-kz $.limits_note: Quote is about account creation time; shared web UI/speed, 'n x 10 Gbit/s' uplink and dedicated IP per plan are not in the capture.
- debrid/elfhosted-prowlarr $.identity_cost.kind: 'Sign-up fee: $1.00' does not say the payment method is a card.
- debrid/megaseed-kz $.free_tier.stated: Quote is the traffic row; the free-seedbox page, 20 GB HDD, 3 torrents and 'Выдача бесплатных сидбоксов остановлена!' are not in the capture.
- debrid/gdflix $.free_tier.stated: Capture has the UNLIMITED sentence but does not say downloading needs no account (only a Google sign-in link is shown).
- debrid/debriditalia $.tooling: Quote proves downloader page and JDownloader; FAQ 'any download manager' and Telegram-announcements parts are not in this capture.
- debrid/debriditalia $.egress: Capture shows per-host daily figures only; the 'unlimited parallel downloads' claim, 'no overall allowance' and the 46,465.05 TB counter are not in it (home capture says 46,489.31 TB).
- debrid/driveseed $.free_tier.stated: UNLIMITED sentence present, but 'need no account' is not stated; the page offers 'Sign in using Google+'.
- debrid/debriditalia $.limits: Status table supports the five per-host figures; 'per user per day' is not on status.php (it is in the news capture) and 'no overall allowance' is an absence claim.
- debrid/filepress $.endpoint: Capture shows only the placeholder '{Domain}/api/v1/file/add'; the host api.filebee.xyz is not part of the quoted route and liveness is not shown.
- debrid/driveseed $.identity_cost.kind: Page says users must sign up through Google and grant Drive permissions; that contradicts 'anonymous'.
- debrid/hubdrive $.interface_detail: Capture has 'Click the Sign In button' and a /sign link; the page title 'G-Drive File Sharing Site ! Shorten your Google Drive Links.' is not in the capture.
- debrid/driveseed $.limits: Quote is a Drive rate-limit changelog line; it does not say per-IP shaping or that the throttle is inherited.
- debrid/elfhosted-prowlarr $.notes: Quote proves indexer manager; 'standard Newznab and Torznab endpoints over HTTPS' for Prowlarr is not in the capture.
- debrid/gdflix $.reliability_note: Quote shows gdflix.pro is a ParkLogic portal; the 2026-10-23 three-host test, refusal and redirect to new7.gdflix.io are not in it.
- debrid/hubcloud $.free_tier.stated: Quote proves 'No account linking needed'; the page does not say generating is free or print any price statement.
- debrid/debriditalia $.price_per_tb_month: Quote proves EUR 18,49 / 365 days; the EUR 3,90 per 30 days FAQ price is not in the capture, and 'per TB' is not stated.
- debrid/driveseed $.binding: A rate-limit changelog line does not establish a per-ip-shaping binding.
- debrid/megaseed-kz $.egress: Capture proves 'не лимитирован'; the Kazakhtelecom internal-traffic sentence is in the FAQ capture, not this one.
- debrid/debriditalia $.limits_note: Status table proves 3.50-50.00 GB range across 24 hosts; per-user-per-day, home-page 'unlimited parallel downloads' and absence of fair-use text are not in this capture.
- debrid/elfhosted-prowlarr $.tooling: Capture says Prowlarr manages indexers and users add their own indexer accounts; NZBHydra 2 appears only as a related product and the identity-cost conclusion is inference.
- debrid/debriditalia $.reliability_note: Servers 4 and P.I. 02707310807 are on the page, but payment runs via a Revolut checkout link, not a WhatsApp chat; contradicts the value.
- debrid/elfhosted-prowlarr $.binding: Sign-up fee does not establish a write-gated binding.
